## Requirements

1. `subagent_anchor` graduates into `OBLIGATIONS` with a real evaluator —
   joins the parent's `control.subagent.spawned` row to the child run's
   `lifecycle.run.created` (spawn_event/parent_anchor, I-A6) + a
   `result|cancelled` (or declared `detached` terminal) carrying the
   child head; unmet fires.
2. `producer_resolution` graduates with a real evaluator — every
   non-kernel `producer.component_variant_ref` resolves to a loaded,
   pin-attested extension or a sealed-definition member (registered
   producer at the recorded version); unmet fires.
3. `DEFERRED_OBLIGATIONS` → empty (custody is not an obligation id);
   `obligations_deferred` reports the empty set.
4. Tests prove each obligation fires on a corrupted fixture and passes
   on the honest one.
5. DF-S1.15-1 dated note: links DONE; custody → R4.15e; the note
   enumerates the row's full scope-column membership with a dated
   marker / landed-here disposition per member.

## Plan

1. `hh-ledger/src/audit.rs` — two `obligation(...)` rows graduate into
   `OBLIGATIONS` (pattern: `fleet_anchor` S4.9 / `evolution_link` S6.1a);
   `DEFERRED_OBLIGATIONS` → `&[]`; `eval_obligations`/`eval_obligation`
   gain `manifest: &RunManifest` + `other_events: &dyn Fn(&str) ->
   Option<Vec<EventEnvelope>>` (the cross-run resolver the real join
   needs — `audit_view` threads it; `other_head` alone can't see child
   rows).
2. `subagent_anchor` evaluator: `spawned{child_run_id}` joins a
   `result|cancelled|detached` naming the same child (`delegation_ref`
   re-names the spawned row's decision ref); child seq-0
   `lifecycle.run.created` manifest verifies `spawn_event` ==
   {parent, spawned.event_id}, `parent_run_id` == parent,
   `extra.parent_anchor` == `parent_head_at_spawn`; `child_head{seq,
   hash}` verifies against the child prefix's `events[seq].hash`;
   `cancelled{spawn_interrupted}` discharges only when the child run
   is not held; `detached` (T6) needs the created-row anchors, no head.
   `terminal_only = true` (a mid-run spawned-without-terminal is
   pending, not a violation).
3. `producer_resolution` evaluator: `component_variant_ref` ∈ {"", "none"}
   skips; `component_class == "kernel"` resolves by construction (Rule-P
   adjudicated — kernel components are the sealed definition's own
   members); every other producer's ref must equal a
   `security.extension.loaded{extension_id|content|resolved}` or a
   `lifecycle.registry.*{version_id}` or the manifest `harness_def_ref`.
4. `audit_view` signature + `Store::project` closure + the
   `s4_14b_rotation`/`s3_11b` call sites updated for the new params.
5. `crates/hh-ledger/tests/r4_7f.rs` — the fire/pass matrix below.
6. DF-S1.15-1 dated note (member enumeration); BL-05 progress append;
   ADR for the owned evaluator-semantics decisions.

## Test matrix

| Leg | Test | Result |
|---|---|---|
| honest spawn→result (anchors + child_head verified) | `subagent_anchor_honest` | pass |
| spawned, no terminal, parent finished | `subagent_anchor_missing_terminal_fires` | pass |
| result without `child_head` | `subagent_anchor_no_head_fires` | pass |
| forged `child_head.hash` | `subagent_anchor_forged_head_fires` | pass |
| `child_head.seq` out of range | `subagent_anchor_wrong_seq_fires` | pass |
| child `spawn_event` mismatch | `subagent_anchor_spawn_event_mismatch_fires` | pass |
| child `parent_anchor` mismatch | `subagent_anchor_parent_anchor_mismatch_fires` | pass |
| `cancelled{spawn_interrupted}`, child never opened | `subagent_anchor_spawn_interrupted_discharges` | pass |
| `spawn_interrupted` claim but child held | `subagent_anchor_interrupted_contradicted_fires` | pass |
| `detached` terminal, valid child anchors | `subagent_anchor_detached_discharges` | pass |
| `detached` but child unheld | `subagent_anchor_detached_unheld_fires` | pass |
| terminal `delegation_ref` mismatch | `subagent_anchor_delegation_ref_mismatch_fires` | pass |
| spawned mid-run (not finished) | `subagent_anchor_pending_while_unfinished` | pass |
| kernel producer + internal label | `producer_resolution_kernel_label_met` | pass |
| `"none"`/empty variant ref skips | `producer_resolution_none_and_empty_skip` | pass |
| non-kernel producer, unresolved ref | `producer_resolution_unresolved_fires` | pass |
| ref → `security.extension.loaded{extension_id|content|resolved}` | `producer_resolution_loaded_extension_met` | pass |
| ref → `harness_def_ref` sealed def | `producer_resolution_sealed_definition_met` | pass |
| ref → `lifecycle.registry.*{version_id}` | `producer_resolution_registry_met` | pass |
| stale version (ref ≠ loaded pin) | `producer_resolution_stale_version_fires` | pass |
| unresolved ref → `audit_view` unmet | `producer_resolution_unresolved_fires_via_audit_view` | pass |
| `obligations_deferred == []`, both ids in `obligations_checked`, `coverage_ok` flips | `coverage_membership_and_completeness` | pass |
